stories.title: New Law to Ban Depraved Child-Like Sexual Abuse Dolls
stories.summary: The Home Office has introduced new legislation to ban child-like sexual abuse dolls, continuing efforts to strengthen child protection laws in the UK.

stories.title: UK Summons Serbian Chargé d'Affaires Over War Criminal Funeral Commemorations
stories.summary: The Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office summoned the Serbian Chargé d'Affaires to the United Kingdom to condemn commemorations surrounding the funeral of a convicted war criminal.

stories.title: Retailers Target 100,000 Jobs for Young People in Major Work Experience Drive
stories.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions announced a partnership with the retail sector aiming to create 100,000 job and work experience opportunities for young people, as part of the government's youth employment push.

agencies.name: DEFRA
agencies.description: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

stories.title: Heatwaves and Drought Lead to Early Grape Harvest Across UK
stories.summary: BBC News reports that extreme heatwaves and drought conditions are driving an unusually early grape harvest in the UK. DEFRA said it was working with the wine industry to address pressures and ensure support schemes work effectively.

stories.title: Precision Bred Organism Release Notice Issued (PBR/26/010)
stories.summary: DEFRA issued a precision-bred organism release notice, with the release scheduled for on or after 10 September 2026, reflecting ongoing implementation of the UK's precision breeding regulatory framework.

stories.title: Two More Men Arrested for Illegal Waste Dumping at Kidlington Site
stories.summary: Two further individuals — a 21-year-old from Ashford and a 43-year-old from Stanwell — were arrested in connection with illegal waste dumping at a Kidlington site, bringing total arrests to six.

stories.title: Some Veterans to Be Called Up to Test UK's War Resilience in 'Military Gap Year' Scheme
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence is piloting a scheme to call up some veterans to test the UK's war resilience, described as a 'military gap year' aimed at assessing the nation's ability to mobilise experienced personnel.

stories.title: UK Pledges Winter Air Defence Package to Boost Ukraine's Defences
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence announced a new winter air defence package for Ukraine, aimed at strengthening Ukrainian air defences ahead of the winter months.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: Cat Little Appointed as New Permanent Secretary for BIST
stories.summary: The Cabinet Secretary, with Prime Ministerial approval, has appointed Cat Little as the new Permanent Secretary of the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST).

stories.title: Government Publishes Vision for AI-Enabled Clean Energy System
stories.summary: The government published a call for evidence setting out a vision for using AI to transform the UK's clean energy system, with Minister McCluskey arguing AI can make energy more affordable, create good jobs, and support a cleaner, more secure grid.

stories.title: Semiconductor Sector Study Published
stories.summary: BIST and DSIT jointly published a semiconductor sector study, as the government continues to pursue its semiconductor strategy and assess the UK's position in the global chip supply chain.

stories.title: Netcompany Wins £215 Million Contract for NHS Screening Modernisation
stories.summary: NHS England has awarded a £215 million contract to Danish tech firm Netcompany to deliver and transform the digital services underpinning the UK's adult screening programmes, in a major NHS digital modernisation push.

stories.title: Northampton General Hospital Completes Next Phase of EPR Implementation
stories.summary: Northampton General Hospital has gone live with the next phase of its electronic patient record (EPR) system, including the patient administration system, marking continued progress in the trust's digital transformation journey.

stories.title: Uckfield Residents Slam 'Diabolical' Post Office Closure for Six Months
stories.summary: Residents of Uckfield, East Sussex, are expressing strong opposition to the planned closure of their local Post Office branch for approximately six months, calling it 'diabolical' and 'ridiculous' given the impact on the local community.
